scope: Actual git blobs at fixed parallel branch tips; no application execution or source mutation

comparisons.ours: Guest and CUSTOMER both receive POST /cart/items form; guest submit relies on AuthFilter302 fixed product GET return.
comparisons.member: Only authenticated users receive POST form; in-stock guest receives login link with product returnUrl, sold-out guest disabled button.
comparisons.decision: Take only the guest conditional/link pattern; retain ours authenticated form, raw quantity error redisplay, fixed min/max1–99, marker data-add-cart and recovery links. Add guest-link marker data-login-to-add.
comparisons.reason: User explicitly selected this UX; avoids unnecessary guest POST while preserving backend defense and manual resubmission.

comparisons.ours: Invalid quantity switches input to text to preserve raw abc; failed input and original status/current product view redisplay. productId field-error anchor exists.
comparisons.member: Number input remains number; quantityInput/cartConflict model and different form marker data-add-to-cart; conflicts disable fieldset.
comparisons.decision: Keep ours model/error behavior; no import of member model names, fieldset conflict policy or quantityInput.
comparisons.reason: Selective merge must not replace API/view contract or erase invalid raw values; valid-user form data marker remains compatible.

comparisons.ours: CartPage quantity/validSubtotal/itemCount/invalidCount/hasInvalidItems/allValid; root data-cart-item-count/quantity/invalid-count/all-valid; rows data-cart-valid/data-invalid-reason; separate action markers and numeric subtotal attrs.
comparisons.member: CartPage totalQuantity/total/checkoutAllowed; root data-checkout-allowed/data-cart-total-quantity; row data-valid; form markers data-cart-quantity-form/data-cart-remove-form.
comparisons.decision: Keep all ours U05 model, selectors and template.
comparisons.reason: Both are parallel view contracts; mixing them would break tested mapping and evidence tools without functional benefit for requested changes.

comparisons.ours: Failed action keeps submitted quantity/version while other forms use current version; disappeared target has readonly failed-submission summary.
comparisons.member: On cartConflict, row fieldset/removal disabled and hidden versions use current item.version; explicit reload note.
comparisons.decision: Keep ours conflict semantics and raw submitted version; optional wording may be considered without view-model changes.
comparisons.reason: Prevents quiet rebasing of a stale submission; full existing recovery behavior is already independently audited.

comparisons.ours: Labels connect unique item-ID-prefixed quantity inputs; generic button labels appear in their table row.
comparisons.member: Quantity label adds hidden product name; update/remove buttons include product-specific aria-label.
comparisons.decision: Optional small improvement only if parent elects it; not required for guest/status changes. Do not import global CSS or different IDs.
comparisons.reason: Product-specific accessible labels are a concrete small improvement, unlike replacing the page layout.

comparisons.ours: Stable data-cart-link, #cart-quantity, data-cart-quantity and data-cart-quantity-unavailable; unavailable state renders dash in the same span.
comparisons.member: No data-cart-link; cartQuantityAvailable flag drives either numeric span or separate unavailable text span.
comparisons.decision: Keep ours layout and marker/error flag contract.

comparisons.ours: CartService.quantityFor -> CartItemMapper.selectQuantity uses COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) WHERE user_id, no join.
comparisons.member: CartService.quantity -> CartItemMapper.sumQuantity uses same SUM SQL; separate COUNT(*) is only countKinds for20-SKU validation.
comparisons.decision: Keep ours method names and implementation; report both satisfy all-row badge rule.
comparisons.reason: COUNT kinds must not be mistaken for a badge bug; no functional badge-query advantage to port.

comparisons.ours: Resolves authenticated CUSTOMER, fallback revalidation for direct Boot/error views, clear invalid identity; query failure flag prevents repeat query and generic500 can show unavailable dash.
comparisons.member: Uses request CURRENT_USER_ATTRIBUTE only; catches DataAccessException or TransactionException and displays unavailable on existing response.
comparisons.decision: Keep ours model and error-status behavior.
comparisons.reason: Preserves tested error-page identity fallback and technical-error500 policy; swallowing failures or changing flag names is outside selected improvements.

comparisons.ours: AuthFilter +10 verifies identity, marks wrong-role cartPOST; CsrfFilter +20 runs next; CartRoleConfiguration MVC preHandle rejects role before parameter binding.
comparisons.member: AuthFilter +10 rejects protected wrong role immediately, before CsrfFilter +20. No CartRoleConfiguration.
comparisons.decision: Keep ours deferred cartPOST role flow.
comparisons.reason: Detailed STEP07 order is identity -> CSRF -> role -> fields; errors share403 but stable code distinguishes actual rejection order.

comparisons.ours: CartRequestNavigation derives only fixed /products/{positiveLongId} or/cart GET; no POST replay.
comparisons.member: NonGET fallback in AuthFilter is/; normal guest UI link already carries safe detail GET return.
comparisons.decision: Take member guest link but retain ours backend fixed read destination for crafted/no-JS/direct POSTs.
comparisons.reason: Frontend UX and backend defense are complementary; ordinary guest link must not remove backend protection.
